authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives both Oriya dhuḷi and dialectal dhūri dust within the same dhūḍi/dhūli family. The neighbouring Bhatri/Adivasi Oriya duṛli/dūrli forms contain both liquids and are placed in that family as a qualified regional comparison, not as evidence for an asserted regular insertion rule. The source’s aspiration and liquid spellings are unchanged.
